title: Agy and Claude Settings Reinstall Bypass Bug and Fine-grained Approval Setup
desc: Resolves settings.json mtime bypass bug during session init for Antigravity-cli (Agy), and configures fine-grained wildcard approvals (e.g., Bash(*)) for Claude Desktop to prevent security prompts without breaking tool safety.
steps: T1 CORE (Decision Rules): In Claude and Gemini, bypassing security/confirmation prompts for command executions requires explicit prefix-based rules like "command(git)" and "command(powershell)" in the permissions.allow array. The global installer must proactively configure these wildcard prefix targets.

T2 HOWTO (Procedure): Overhaul Test-HarnessNeedsReinstall in wkharness-session-init.ps1 and 08-harness-connection.ps1 to verify that all required command prefixes (command(git), unsandboxed(git), command(powershell), command(bash), command(cmd), command(sh), command(gh), command(wkappbot) and their unsandboxed equivalents) are fully present. If any required entry is missing, trigger a reinstall of settings.json immediately.

T3 REF (History): Incident 2026-06-09: The installer failed to update settings.json because it only checked for "Bash(*)" or "*", leaving specific git/shell command executions prompting. After updating the validation logic, run "wkdoctor" to trigger the auto-installer to self-heal. NOTE: The running agent session loads permissions at startup and does not hot-reload settings.json; a session restart is required to activate new settings.

CASING FIX (2026-06-14, edc737f): Claude Code REQUIRES UPPERCASE permission tool names -- Command(...) / Unsandboxed(...) / Mcp(...). A LOWERCASE rule (command(*), unsandboxed(git), mcp(*)) is silently SKIPPED at startup with 'Invalid permission rule command(*) was skipped: Use Command'. Antigravity-cli (Gemini) uses the lowercase form -- keep that ONLY in its own settings file, never in ~/.claude/settings.json. Step 1 above (which says rules like command(git)/command(powershell)) describes the AGY lowercase form and is WRONG for Claude. Root cause of recurrence: wk-approval-sync.ps1 WROTE lowercase into the Claude file, re-breaking what wkdoctor module 20 (20-claude-settings-validation.ps1) had just capitalized -- a heal/reinject ping-pong. Fix: writer wk-approval-sync.ps1 + validator wkharness-session-init-infra.ps1 Test-HarnessNeedsReinstall now both emit/expect UPPERCASE for Claude and lowercase only for antigravity-cli. wkdoctor module 20 already DETECTS+HEALS lowercase rules (capitalize first letter, .wkdoctor-bak backup, verify-reparse, atomic UTF-8 write) -- run wkdoctor to self-heal a live file.
